merge2.a11y.simple: (Menu): each step shows only its answer in short sentences and one big button; "Show more" brings the rest back. Farming terms can be tapped for a plain explanation.
merge2.a11y.text: (Menu): 100% to 200%, with the layout kept usable.
merge2.a11y.colours: same as your device, light or dark (the map stays satellite).
merge2.a11y.describe: (step 2): a short spoken and written summary of the field and this week.
merge2.a11y.print: (step 5): the adviser page at 18 point or larger, black on white.
merge2.a11y.alerts: weather alerts and "too wet to work the field" show as a banner with an icon and words, and are announced to screen readers. Nothing depends on sound.
merge2.a11y.voice: in Ask CropLytics: "open compare", "next step", "read this week", "go to my field" and "describe my field", also in Spanish.
merge2.a11y.keys: 1 to 5 for the steps, / to find a field, l for the list, r to read the answer aloud, ? for this list. They are off while you type.
merge2.a11y.time: nothing closes, moves on or expires by itself. Pop-ups stay until you close them, and the tour only moves when you press Next.
merge2.a11y.lite: (Menu): no 3D, replay or rain animation, fewer downloads, and the last field you opened works with no connection. It turns on by itself on a slow connection or Data Saver.
merge2.fnSees: First Nations, Inuit and tribal lands across the US and Canada{n}: reserves, tribal lands, Inuit Owned and settlement lands. Click one for its Nation panel.
merge2.llPh: Search by reserve, tribe, Nation, community or state
merge2.llHidden: {n} not shown. Search or pick a state to narrow.
merge2.dmErr: The Drought Monitor is not reachable right now.
merge2.gl.acreft.text: The water it takes to cover one acre a foot deep. 1 acre-foot per acre is the same as 12 inches of water over the field.
merge2.gl.fallow.text: A field left unplanted for a season to rest or to save water. The ground is bare.
merge2.gl.rainfed.text: A crop that gets all its water from rain and the soil, with no irrigation.
merge2.gl.groundwater.text: Water stored underground, in the soil and rock below the roots. Wells pump it.
merge2.gl.rotation.text: The order of crops a field grows from year to year, such as rice then fallow.
